args: echo M22_BEGIN; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; echo FONT=$(settings get system font_scale); echo PLANE=$(settings get global airplane_mode_on); echo WIFI=$(settings get global wifi_on); echo DATA=$(settings get global mobile_data); wm density; cmd uimode night; run-as com.cooper.lithic.debug sh -c 'echo NB_BEGIN; find no_backup -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 3 -type f; echo NB_END; test ! -e no_backup/active-generation && test ! -e no_backup/generations && echo DEFAULT_ROOT_ABSENT; if [ -d databases ]; then find databases -type f; else echo NO_DATABASES_DIR; fi'; echo TARGET_PROCESSES; ps -A -o PID,UID,NAME | grep -E "com.cooper.lithic.debug(:| |$)" || true; echo M22_END
